reason: Historical revisions of this file carried the literal PEM banner as a fixture proving release-audit detects it; the banner alone is a format marker with no key material after it.
Synthetic token-shaped fixtures asserting the credential pattern set fires and the fixture-marker allowlist does not; the same file and values .gitleaks.toml already allowlists.
Fixture asserting the Bearer-token pattern fires; the value is the universally published JWT header segment for {alg:HS256,typ:JWT} with no payload or signature.
Asserts the exact Authorization header the Grok proxy transport builds. The credential is the literal string 'secret-token', a hand-written placeholder that never authenticates anything.
Negative test proving validateProviderLinkUrl rejects a URL carrying inline credentials; the 'user:pass@' userinfo makes the host look like an email local part to the scanner.
Same negative test: a credential-bearing URL must appear literally in the source for the rejection to be asserted at all, and the value is the placeholder pair user/pass.
